Chamoli Tunnel Incident: Workers Trapped, Rescued Amidst Water and Debris

An under-construction tunnel in Chamoli, Uttarakhand, experienced a mishap when water and debris entered, trapping workers. Reports indicate varying numbers of fatalities, with some outlets stating six deaths and others nine. A total of 16 to 22 workers were initially reported trapped, with 14 to 18 rescued. As of the coverage, between two and six workers remained unaccounted for or trapped. Rescue operations are ongoing.
